description: AGIS - Above Ground Asset - Shared is a dataset listed in Cadent Gas open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution network operator, published or maintained by Cadent Gas Ltd. We have a number of gas assets that sit above ground. These are usually assets that reduce the pressure of gas so the relevant pressure of gas is sent to the right locations. The shared Data Asset contains the location of such sites along with the pressure reduction that is carried out. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Asset, Shared. Its keywords are Pressure Reduction, AGI, Above Ground Infrastructure, District Governors, Pressure Tier. The portal shows 2025-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Cadent Gas Data Sharing Agreement. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-cadent-open-data-portal.
